label: Cold War Files
titel: The Man Who Ignored the Alarm

szenen.text: September 26, 1983. A Soviet alarm said *nuclear missiles* were coming.
Officer Stanislav Petrov was on duty in the *early-warning bunker.*
The satellite system reported *five* U.S. missiles.
Tensions were *sky-high.* Protocol meant reporting it upward.
Petrov doubted it. A real strike would be *far bigger.*
The cause: sunlight *glinting* off high-altitude clouds.
One decision may have *saved millions.* Would you have done it?

caption: In 1983 a Soviet officer doubted a missile alert and called it a false alarm. It really was. Would you have trusted your gut? AI voice & edit. Footage: Pixabay/Pexels.
